miniskyblock.rule.blazeToBreeze.name: blazeToBreeze
miniskyblock.rule.blazeToBreeze.desc: Blaze will turn into Breeze when going from nether to overworld. Won't affect nametagged entities
miniskyblock.rule.paleBlossomCreakingHea: Growing a pale oak sapling near an open eye blossom produces a creaking heart
miniskyblock.rule.commandSkyIsland.name: commandSkyIsland
miniskyblock.rule.commandSkyIsland.desc: Enables /skyisland command for generating new spawn platforms
miniskyblock.rule.generateEndPortals.des: Generates End Portal frames in a SkyBlock world
Generates Trial Chambers in a SkyBlock world
miniskyblock.rule.generateSilverfishSpaw: Generates Silverfish spawners in a SkyBlock world
miniskyblock.rule.generateAncientCityPor: Generates Ancient City portal frames in a SkyBlock world
miniskyblock.rule.generateMagmaCubeSpawn: Generates Magma Cube spawners in a SkyBlock world
miniskyblock.rule.generateRandomEndGatew: Generates random End Gateways in the Outer End Islands in a SkyBlock world
miniskyblock.rule.skyblockBorderChunks.d: Number of chunks across the SkyBlock world border (e.g. 30 = 30x30 chunks)
miniskyblock.rule.tallFlowersFromWanderi: Allows the Wandering Trader to sell tall flowers
miniskyblock.rule.lavaFromWanderingTrade: Allows the Wandering Trader to sell Lava
miniskyblock.rule.lightningElectrifiesVi: Makes Lightning convert Vines attached to Glowstone into Glow Lichen when it strikes the Glowstone
The Lightning can also strike a Lightning Rod on the Glowstone
miniskyblock.rule.renewableBuddingAmethy: Makes Lava convert into a Budding Amethyst when surrounded by Calcite and Smooth Basalt
miniskyblock.rule.gatewaysSpawnChorus.de: Makes Chorus generate on Endstone Islands generated by End Gateways
miniskyblock.rule.renewableHeartsOfTheSe: Allows Dolphins to dig up Hearts of the Sea when given a Fish
miniskyblock.rule.renewableDragonHeads.d: Makes Ender Dragons drop their heads when killed by a Charged Creepers
miniskyblock.rule.shulkerSpawnsOnDragonK: Makes a Shulker spawn on the Bedrock Pillar when the End Dragon is re-killed
miniskyblock.rule.renewableDiamonds.name: renewableDiamonds
miniskyblock.rule.renewableDiamonds.desc: Allows Falling Anvils to compact stacks of Coal Blocks into a Diamonds
miniskyblock.rule.rammingWart.name: rammingWart
miniskyblock.rule.rammingWart.desc: Allows a ramming Goat to break Nether Wart Blocks into Nether Wart
miniskyblock.rule.foxesSpawnWithSweetBer: Probability that Foxes spawn with Sweet Berries
miniskyblock.rule.poisonousPotatoesConve: Makes Spiders turn into Cave Spiders when right-clicked with a Poisonous Potato
miniskyblock.rule.saplingsDieOnSand.name: saplingsDieOnSand
miniskyblock.rule.saplingsDieOnSand.desc: Allows Saplings to be placed on Sand, but they soon turn into Dead Bushes
miniskyblock.rule.doDeadBushToBush.name: doDeadBushToBush
miniskyblock.rule.doDeadBushToBush.desc: Allows Dead Bushes to be converted into regular Bushes
miniskyblock.rule.renewableEchoShards.de: Makes Creatures with Echolocation (Bats and Dolphins) drop Echo Shards when killed by a Warden's Sonic Boom attack
miniskyblock.rule.allayableVexes.name: allayableVexes
miniskyblock.rule.allayableVexes.desc: Allows Vexes to turn into Allays when played the correct Note Block sequence
miniskyblock.rule.coralErosion.name: coralErosion
miniskyblock.rule.coralErosion.desc: Makes Dead Coral erode into Sand when Water flows out of it
miniskyblock.rule.hugeMushroomsSpreadMyc: Makes Mushrooms spread Mycelium onto dirt-like blocks nearby when Bonemealed into Huge Mushrooms
miniskyblock.rule.renewableNetherrack.de: Makes Netherrack or Nylium generate around Nether Portals that generate midair
miniskyblock.rule.renewableNetherrack.ex: What generates depends on the biome, with Nyliums generating in their respective forests and Netherrack elsewhere
miniskyblock.rule.renewableDeepslate.des: Allows Thick Potions to convert Stone into Deepslate, either by right-clicking or using a splash potion
miniskyblock.rule.renewableDeepslate.ext: With no_splash: splash potion conversion is disabled
miniskyblock.rule.renewableSwiftSneak.de: Allows Enchanting Tables near Wardens to enchant with Swift Sneak
miniskyblock.rule.traderCamels.name: traderCamels
miniskyblock.rule.traderCamels.desc: Traders that spawn in certain biomes ride Camels
miniskyblock.rule.sniffersFromDrowneds.d: Drowneds sometimes spawn holding a Sniffer Egg
miniskyblock.rule.sniffersFromDrowneds.e: When they stomp Turtle Eggs, they replace them with the Sniffer Egg
miniskyblock.rule.suspiciousSniffers.des: Sniffers can convert Sand and Gravel into their suspicious version
miniskyblock.rule.suspiciousSniffers.ext: When Sniffers dig Sand or Gravel in a structure where Suspicious Sand or Gravel generates, it will be converted
With no_iron: No Iron Nugget is dropped when Sniffers dig
miniskyblock.rule.spreadingSmallDripleav: Allows Small Dripleaves to slowly spread to nearby blocks when in the right conditions
Requires them to be on Clay, half-submerged, with the top at light level 5
miniskyblock.rule.spreadingCoral.name: spreadingCoral
miniskyblock.rule.spreadingCoral.desc: Allows Coral to spread to nearby Calcite
miniskyblock.rule.maxWanderingTraderSpaw: This starts at 0.025 and increases by 0.025 each time a trader spawn fails until the max chance is reached
miniskyblock.rule.wanderingTraderSpawnRa: How often the Wandering Trader attempts to spawn in ticks
